articles.title: 4 Dead in Horrific Bike-SUV Collision in Gorakhpur, Groom-to-Be Among Victims
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Gorakhpur, May 31 — Four young men lost their lives in a tragic road accident on the Gorakhpur-Varanasi National Highway near Barahalganj police station limits on Saturday morning.

body.html:
Gorakhpur, May 31 — Four young men lost their lives in a tragic road accident on the Gorakhpur-Varanasi National Highway near Barahalganj police station limits on Saturday morning.

The incident occurred around 9:45 am when a motorcycle carrying the four victims collided head-on with a speeding SUV attempting to overtake a tractor. The impact was so severe that two riders were flung nearly 20 feet into the air, while the other two were dragged for almost 100 meters on the car's bonnet before the vehicle came to a halt. The SUV driver fled the scene, abandoning the vehicle.

The deceased were identified as Sunil Kumar (22), Pradyumn Kumar (22), Arvind Kumar (23), and Rahul Kumar (22) — all whitewash workers from Garthauli Tola in Sidhwapar Gram Sabha. Locals and police rushed them to a community health centre, where Sunil, Pradyumn, and Arvind were declared dead. Rahul succumbed to injuries on the way to the district hospital.

According to neighbours, Pradyumn, Arvind, and Rahul were relatives, while Sunil was a close friend. Rahul was the only child of his parents and was to be engaged on June 1.

Circle Officer Manoj Kumar Pandey confirmed that an FIR has been registered, and efforts are underway to trace the absconding driver.

articles.title: Train Disaster Averted: 12-Foot Iron Pole Found on Tracks in UP's Shamli 🚨
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Shamli, Uttar Pradesh — A major tragedy was narrowly avoided on the Delhi-Saharanpur railway line after a 12-foot long iron pole and small stones were discovered lying on the track in Shamli district.

body.html:
Shamli, Uttar Pradesh — A major tragedy was narrowly avoided on the Delhi-Saharanpur railway line after a 12-foot long iron pole and small stones were discovered lying on the track in Shamli district.

The alert train pilot spotted the obstruction in time and applied emergency brakes, successfully bringing the train to a halt. The train remained stationary for nearly an hour as authorities inspected the area.

Preliminary investigations are underway to determine whether the incident was an act of mischief or part of a larger conspiracy.

articles.title: Naked Protest Turns Violent: Transgender Group Assaults Doctors at Jaunpur Hospital
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Jaunpur, Uttar Pradesh — A shocking incident unfolded on Friday night at the Jaunpur District Hospital when a group of transgender individuals staged a naked protest and physically assaulted medical staff, including a doctor and two health workers.

body.html:
Jaunpur, Uttar Pradesh — A shocking incident unfolded on Friday night at the Jaunpur District Hospital when a group of transgender individuals staged a naked protest and physically assaulted medical staff, including a doctor and two health workers.

The violence reportedly erupted after doctors allegedly refused immediate treatment to an injured member of the transgender community, demanding that an FIR be lodged first. Enraged by this, around 15 to 20 transgender individuals arrived at the hospital around 8:45 p.m. and began creating a ruckus in the emergency ward.

Dr. Pawan Singh, who was on duty, stated that he was attacked when he tried to intervene. Nursing officer Ashish Singh and health worker Amit Singh were also assaulted as they attempted to stop the chaos. Eyewitnesses and viral video footage revealed that the attackers were unclothed and climbed onto emergency tables during the assault.

All three victims suffered injuries and later approached the local police station to file a formal complaint. Dr. Singh has demanded a thorough investigation and strict action against those involved.

The accused fled the hospital premises after the incident.

articles.title: Outspoken Law Student Jailed Over Anti-Pakistan Video: Is Free Speech Under Threat?
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Kolkata, May 31, 2025 — Sharmistha Panoli, a 22-year-old law student from Pune and a social media influencer, was arrested by Kolkata Police from Gurugram, Haryana, on Friday following a viral Instagram video that drew widespread backlash.

body.html:
Kolkata, May 31, 2025 — Sharmistha Panoli, a 22-year-old law student from Pune and a social media influencer, was arrested by Kolkata Police from Gurugram, Haryana, on Friday following a viral Instagram video that drew widespread backlash.

In May 2025, Panoli had posted a video responding to a Pakistani follower's question about India’s military response to the recent Pahalgam terror attack. In the video, she made remarks that were widely condemned as communal and offensive, including comments on Islam and Prophet Muhammad. She also criticized Bollywood celebrities for staying silent on Operation Sindoor, a recent Indian military offensive targeting terrorist camps in Pakistan and Pakistan-occupied-Kashmir.

The video sparked online outrage, threats, and eventually led to a police complaint in Kolkata. An FIR was registered under sections related to promoting enmity between groups and hurting religious sentiments.

Although Panoli deleted the video and issued a public apology, she and her family reportedly went missing after receiving multiple legal notices. A court in Kolkata later issued an arrest warrant.

On May 31, Panoli was arrested and produced before the Chief Judicial Magistrate in Alipore. She has been remanded to judicial custody until June 13, 2025.

Her arrest triggered a heated debate on social media. Hashtags like #ReleaseSharmistha and #FreeSpeechUnderAttack began trending, with several users and public figures, including actor Kangana Ranaut, voicing support and alleging selective prosecution.

articles.title: Taunt Turns Deadly as Husband Takes Chilling Revenge on Wife and Her Lover in Haryana
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Fatehabad-Tohana, Haryana: In a shocking double murder that has sent chills across the region, a husband brutally killed his estranged wife and her live-in partner on a public road in Tohana town, Haryana.

body.html:
Fatehabad-Tohana, Haryana: In a shocking double murder that has sent chills across the region, a husband brutally killed his estranged wife and her live-in partner on a public road in Tohana town, Haryana.

The victims, Pooja (30) and her boyfriend Ritik (24), were walking together when Pooja’s husband Deepak launched a frenzied knife attack. Pooja was stabbed 11 times, while Ritik succumbed after 3 fatal blows. Both died on the spot.

Deepak and Pooja had been married for 14 years and had two children. But things fell apart when Pooja began a relationship with Ritik and left her family to live with him. Allegedly, tensions escalated when Pooja taunted Deepak, saying, “You can’t do anything.”

Consumed by rage and humiliation, Deepak plotted his terrifying revenge, killing the couple in cold blood. The horrifying act was witnessed by locals, and Deepak was arrested shortly after the incident.

Police have taken him into custody, and an investigation is underway.

articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Ambedkar Nagar, Uttar Pradesh: In a major crackdown on corruption, the Anti-Corruption Organization (ACB) team on Friday afternoon arrested Lekhpal Arun Kumar Yadav while accepting a bribe of ₹10,000 in Jalalpur Tehsil.

body.html:
Ambedkar Nagar, Uttar Pradesh: In a major crackdown on corruption, the Anti-Corruption Organization (ACB) team on Friday afternoon arrested Lekhpal Arun Kumar Yadav while accepting a bribe of ₹10,000 in Jalalpur Tehsil.

The action followed a complaint by Indu Devi, a resident of Basia village, who alleged that the Lekhpal was demanding money for preparing a report related to her ancestral property.

The trap was executed by the Ayodhya Mandal ACB unit under Inspector Virendra Kumar Yadav. Arun Kumar Yadav was caught red-handed near Sahu Kirana Store in Jalalpur while taking the bribe.

After the arrest, he was taken to an undisclosed location for further interrogation. A case has been filed at Baskhari police station, and the Jalalpur SDM confirmed the operation.
